data.name: Bujji
data.gender_notes: Bujji is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bujji is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. This name symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and the blessings of the goddess. It is believed that using this name will attract wealth and good fortune. The name Bujji carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bujji usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine blessings and abundance.
data.etymology: Bujji belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bujji total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Bujji was a famous Chola warrior and commander during the reign of Rajaraja Chola I (985-1014 AD). He is best known for his victory over the Cheras in the Battle of Vallanadu in 1002 AD.

Another Bujji, a Jaina monk and philosopher, lived during the 13th century AD. He was a prominent figure in the Digambara monastic tradition and is known for his works on Jaina metaphysics and epistemology.
